meta.name: mcp-builder
meta.description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).

copy.tagline: 构建高质量 MCP 服务器，让 LLM 调用外部服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为 LLM 创建 MCP 服务器来集成外部 API 或服务。
copy.tagline_en: Build high-quality MCP servers to let LLMs call external services
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create MCP servers for LLMs to integrate external APIs or services.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的需求，指导你一步步创建 MCP 服务器，包括研究 API、编写代码、测试和生成评估问题。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 帮助构建一个 MCP 服务器（例如连接外部 API 或服务）时触发，支持 Python 或 TypeScript。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 MCP 服务器，连接 GitHub API。
say.note: Claude 会开始研究并规划实现步骤。

say.text: 为我的 MCP 服务器生成 10 个评估问题。
say.note: Claude 会创建测试服务器效果的问答对。

say.text: 用 TypeScript 实现一个 MCP 工具，用于搜索文档。
say.note: Claude 会编写代码并指导测试。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you step-by-step through creating an MCP server, including researching APIs, writing code, testing, and generating evaluation questions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to help build an MCP server (e.g., to connect an external API or service), supporting Python or TypeScript.

say_en.text: Help me create an MCP server that connects to the GitHub API.
say_en.note: Claude will start researching and planning the implementation.

say_en.text: Generate 10 evaluation questions for my MCP server.
say_en.note: Claude will create Q&A pairs to test the server's effectiveness.

say_en.text: Implement an MCP tool in TypeScript for searching documents.
say_en.note: Claude will write code and guide testing.
